findings.issue: Preview/approval/read-back and section-text behaviour (10-minute token expiry, workiva_stage_section_text / workiva_confirm_section_text, lines 29-37) is taken from the L1/L3 specs and written in the present tense, but those lanes are not merged yet. The task says 'Do not invent controls the code does not have; when unsure, mark the item open'. The worker's report admits this was not checked against code.
findings.fix: Before the demo, check these lines against the merged L1/L3 code, or add a short note that the change-set and section-text controls are as specified in lanes L1/L3 and still waiting on merge.

findings.issue: There are two extra open risks beyond the four required (single-replica deployment, optional Azure paths). The 'at least' wording allows this and both are true to the repo, so this is in scope.

The 'What is written and how' section states change-set and section-text behaviour in the present tense as built controls: 10-minute token expiry, one update per sheet, no retry after an uncertain outcome, read-back statuses. That behaviour comes from the L1/L3 specs (demo-l1-change-set.md R5/R8/R9/R11, demo-l3-section-text.md R9), which are not merged. The code today has a 5-minute pendingWriteTTL in internal/mcpserver/tools/update_field.go:24. The worker report admits this, but the brief does not. The task says 'Do not invent controls the code does not have; when unsure, mark the item open'.
findings.fix: Either add a one-line note that the change-set and section-text flows are described as specified for the demo (lanes L1/L3), or recheck the figures against the merged code before the brief goes to the firm's IT team.

findings.issue: 'Writes are not retried after an uncertain outcome; the status says so' does not name the status. The specs define it as reconciliation_required.
findings.fix: Name `reconciliation_required` so IT can match it to tool output and audit rows.
